cases.note: Inline bodies get the parent's failure module (FX-5), and stored nodes hold a copy of it (CF-V4), so no loop of such a flow collapses.

note: Which loops collapse (FX-46, CF-8): a sequential for loop or any while loop whose body is one script or rawscript step with none of the disqualifying fields, in a flow with no failure module.
